interpretation: Physical downloaded image coverage across all available research batches; not individual batch deficits, not the larger 530-place catalogue.
caveats: The initial 100 archive consists of optimized JPEG research previews, not necessarily native Commons originals.
133 byte-distinct images validated across local original A100, B15 and B16 archives (94+23+16); B15 SHA256 are in B15 original manifest, not repeated in this compact repository ledger.
A 'preliminarily matching' subject may still have poor resolution, be a contextual site image, have copyright/underlying artwork uncertainty or lack final approval.
The 117 have no downloaded image in these audited archives; many have custodian reference URLs and 19 have historic search-lead lists (81 total), not all unresearched.
20 existing KEEP decisions remain protected; two (Loreto Madonna and Banneux chapel) currently have no matching downloaded file in audited archives.
Do not infer any release or transfer editorial KEEP to a different image. No photographs newly approved or published.
B16's 128 no-download was a count scoped to B16 138-target retry, not the cumulative missing count.
